title: Billing Operations Standard: Correcting Residential Electricity Supply Lines
content:
Billing operations standard for over-billed Residential Electricity Supply lines.

## Rules in force

1. **Rebill credit.** When a supply line was billed at more than the policy allows, the over-billed amount is returned as one rebill credit tied to that line, the rebill credit naming the original line it corrects.
2. **Lookback.** A line may be corrected only when the customer disputes it no later than the billing correction lookback, in calendar months, after the line was posted. The lookback ends on the same day of the month that many months after the posting date, or on the last day of that month when that day does not exist; a dispute made on that last day is within the lookback. The test reads the posting date of the disputed line.
3. **Once per line.** Each billed line may be corrected only once; a line that already has a rebill credit pointing at it is not corrected again.
4. **No back-billing.** Under-billing caused by a Beacon Ridge rate or fee error is not back-billed.
5. **Meter readings.** Usage disputes about the kWh the utility measured are not corrected by Beacon Ridge, because meter readings belong to the utility.

## Retired clauses

The following clauses are **no longer in force**:

- "The rebill credit equals the billed amount minus the correctly computed amount for the same line, rounded per the supply charge rounding, and is posted as a negative amount." It is superseded by the current Residential Electricity Supply basis for the amount of a rebill credit.
- "A care agent may post a rebill credit up to the care agent adjustment limit; a larger correction is not posted as an adjustment but opened as a billing dispute for review, which settles it." It is superseded by the current Residential Electricity Supply basis for corrections above the care agent's adjustment limit.

## Lookback boundaries (hypothetical posting dates, using the 12-month lookback every plan carries)

| Line posted | Lookback ends | Dispute on | Correctable |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2025-03-31 | 2026-03-31 | 2026-03-31 | yes, last day |
| 2025-03-31 | 2026-03-31 | 2026-04-01 | no |
| 2024-02-29 | 2025-02-28, as 2025-02-29 does not exist | 2025-02-28 | yes |
| 2025-07-15 | 2026-07-15 | 2026-07-16 | no |

A customer who says the meter over-recorded their kWh is disputing the utility's reading, which Beacon Ridge does not correct; a customer whose kWh were billed at a rate the plan does not allow has an over-billed line.

superseded_clauses: The rebill credit equals the billed amount_usd minus the correctly computed amount for the same line, rounded per supply_charge_rounding, and is posted as a negative amount.
A care agent may post a rebill credit up to agent_adjustment_limit_usd; a larger correction is not posted as an adjustment but opened as a billing dispute for review, which settles it.
